verdict.rationale: Stable pairs its virtual/business address with a registered agent service usable for foreign qualification and legal/state correspondence (stable-docs-19,20,22,27,31), and models a 'Company' legal entity object for organizing addresses under an entity (stable-docs-37). However there is no evidence of an LLC formation service or residency-grade (personal) addresses offered from the same provider. Missing for 10: explicit LLC/entity formation product, residency-grade personal address option, and any independent confirmation these bundle seamlessly with formation.
